verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs say users can save passkeys in the vault and autofill them on websites and apps through the browser extension and mobile apps. Its llms.txt also lists passkeys alongside passwords as a core managed credential type. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the passkey creation and sign-in flow, platform coverage details (which OS and app integrations are supported), and independent or hands-on confirmation that passkey sign-in works.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension or mobile apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
The most trusted open source password manager for passwords, passkeys, and secrets
